scope: Public Python workflows and self-contained dataset inputs, with offline behavioral analysis, feature/sample associations, bounded encoding and browser checks. Complete historical paper reproduction and dataset publication are not asserted.

tests.skip_reason: Optional model-tokenizer caches and separate sliding-window replay fixtures are unavailable; all six recorded-human-data integration tests ran.

quality_gates.lint_and_format: Ruff check and Ruff format --check pass across src/, agents/, tests/, tools/ and the manifest assembler (105 scoped files).
quality_gates.dataset_assembly: Tests cover stale retained payloads, frozen source identities, safe atomic replacements, content hashes, catalogue types and source-to-public path consistency.

human_replay.mode: Action-only replay through the actual Python entrypoint, followed by the feature prompt loader

generic_feature_extraction.purpose: CPU entrypoint/interface validation using synthetic weights; does not reproduce paper activations
generic_feature_extraction.model: Locally initialized tiny Llama with a fast ChatML tokenizer

representative_checks.extraction_failure_status: Generic, V3.2 and V4 batch tests distinguish completed, skipped and failed sessions; continuation retains successful outputs while still failing the command when any selected session fails.

efficientzero.checkpoint_attribution: These checks use an available checkpoint; attribution of every final-paper feature array remains unresolved.

representative_checks.ddqn: Tiny CPU training/runtime check and recorded-trajectory extraction contract with explicitly synthetic weights; no performance-reproduction claim.
representative_checks.neural_integration: Synthetic NIfTI/confounds, base and LLM alignment, main/nuisance ridge fitting and ROI aggregation.
representative_checks.figures: Behavioral figures from complete episode histories and the retained summary table, and the archived neural figure, ran using the dataset package with network connections and source-service imports blocked.
representative_checks.baseline_human_inputs: All 12,775 pilot frames produce identical DDQN grids, alignment timing, nuisance inputs and EfficientZero RGB/grayscale inputs compared with original measurements. Additional EfficientZero checks cover early-cohort and fractional-position trajectories.
representative_checks.text_observation_generator: Lazy imports, CLI help and fake vLLM batching across files; no real vLLM GPU generation.

feature_alignment.scope: Recorded arrays independently realigned from frozen features/theory JSON and human clocks; coverage gaps remain explicit.
feature_alignment.recorded_play_identity: Exact participant/run/original-document IDs take precedence over timestamp proximity, with original-frame timestamp validation and conflicting-identity rejection.

not_executed: Full fMRIPrep container execution on participant MRI.
Whole-cohort preprocessing and complete paper encoding fits.
Large-model GPU/distributed extraction or paper model-performance reproduction.
Complete multimodal dataset staging, payload hashing or Hugging Face upload.
data_boundary: Participant payloads and catalogue tables belong to the separate dataset package. This Git repository contains implementations, specifications and aggregate validation evidence.
dataset_package_validation: Separate local HF package loaded through its README configurations with datasets 4.8.5 using split=data. Both catalogue configurations loaded successfully; no remote upload was performed.
reproduction_limits: See ../reproduction-limits.md for unresolved checkpoint/layer attribution, coverage gaps and condition distinctions.
